Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.teavm.js

Class GraphVizEngineJs

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.teavm.js.GraphVizEngineJs
public class GraphVizEngineJs extends Object
Renders DOT graphs to SVG with Viz.js, synchronously.

In @viz-js/viz 3.x, only Viz.instance() is asynchronous (it loads the WebAssembly module); renderString on the instance is synchronous. So the instance is created once, from JavaScript (prepare(ScriptLoaderJs.Ok)), and kept on the global object as __plantumlVizInstance; rendering then just calls it. Nothing waits in Java: when the instance is not ready yet, rendering notes it as missing and fails, and the diagram is rendered again once it is ready (see PendingResources).

Usage: 

 String svg = GraphVizEngineJs.renderDotToSvg("digraph G { A -> B; }");

  • Method Details

    • vizMissingFallback

      public static boolean vizMissingFallback()
      True when the Viz.js bridge (viz-global.js) is NOT loaded on the page, so the caller should fall back to the Smetana layout engine. Logs a one-time console note the first time the fallback is taken.

      A Viz.js that is loaded but whose instance cannot be created (the WebAssembly module fails to load) is not a fallback: the diagram reports that failure, naming Viz.

    • isAvailable

      public static boolean isAvailable()
      Whether a layout can call renderDotToSvg(String) now: the instance is there, or creating it failed (which renderDotToSvg then reports). When it is not there yet, it is noted as missing and this returns false: the attempt will be discarded and rendered again once the instance is ready, so the caller should stop at once rather than compute a layout for nothing.

    • forgetFailure

      public static void forgetFailure()
      Forgets why creating the instance failed, so that the next request tries again: a network failure while loading the WebAssembly module may be transient. Called at the start of each request.

    • prepare

      public static void prepare(ScriptLoaderJs.Ok done)
      Creates the Viz.js instance, once, and calls done when it is there or when creating it failed (the reason is then kept as __plantumlVizError, until the next request: see forgetFailure()), or at once when there is nothing to wait for. Concurrent calls share the same creation.
